title: TLS
description: TLS configuration for the virtual host.

secretName.description: Name of the Kubernetes Secret containing the TLS certificate and private key. May reference a Secret in another namespace if TLSCertificateDelegation is configured.

minimumProtocolVersion.description: Minimum TLS protocol version to negotiate.

passthrough.description: If true, TLS termination is done at the backend service.

enableFallbackCertificate.description: If true, a default fallback certificate is served for SNI names that don't match any configured virtual host.
